## F — Traffic sign shapes, colors and signals
Research index: Traffic sign shapes, colors and signals; part C has 19 facts and part C2 has 15 continuation facts, each with a single page of record.
Exam identity and issuer are in A; applicant scope is in B; fact and continuation registries are C and C2; accuracy handling is D; market debt is E and competitive debt E2.
VERIFY: WY-SEC16-EXAM — written-test count, bank size, format and time limit unknown.
WY-SEC16-PASS — official written-test passing standard unknown.
WY-SEC16-FRESH — printed-source currency and effective date unverified.
WY-sec-SIGNS-MARKET — demand research missing.
WY-SIGNS-COMPETITORS — competitor research missing.
WY-SEC16-SCHOOL-LIMIT-CONFLICT — Physical page 96 calls the school-zone limit absolute, while page 41 places school zones in an unless-otherwise-posted list. No unsupported reconciliation of the absolute qualifier is taught.
WY-SEC16-RED-ARROW-EXPLANATION — Physical page 97 says a red arrow reminds drivers they must turn in that direction when green, without establishing dedicated-lane context. The later mandatory-turn implication is withheld; the explicit red-arrow prohibition is retained.
WY-SEC16-VISUAL-PRACTICE — Text descriptions do not certify learner recognition of rendered signs. Dedicated visual practice needs a later sourced implementation; no handbook image is reproduced in this dossier.
Dynamic facts: Posted restrictions and present legal applicability remain source-currency issues. No ENS phone number, diagram-derived contact detail or new school-zone time condition is invented.
Source confidence is about fidelity to the staged handbook; independent 07/08 review and current legal applicability remain separate.
